original_prototype.title: Storm-damaged teaching bench
original_prototype.setting: Existing-style local work circle, no new world or required family system
original_prototype.prerequisite: Older authorization,dated closure and keeper testimony available through actual observation; bench condition and authority tracked independently.
choices: compare old authorization to posted closure
inspect actual brace with paid time
original_prototype.real_cost: Conserved wood/kit,usable body,shared played time and finite keeper fee; numerical balance unselected.
original_prototype.mutation: Scoped repair right and accepted funded job after supported evidence/consent; teaching remains unavailable until actual repair.
original_prototype.downstream_consumer: Repair enables useful bench teaching/work; actual completed work pays once from reserved funds.
original_prototype.failure_or_aftermath: Identity match with invalid authorization starts no paid job; failed support/cancellation uses declared refund; closure and correction receipts survive display-memory pruning; independent refusal creates no fee or affection debt.
original_prototype.compatibility: Integrator selects any added evidence/rule carrier; old absent optional state inert; retain one publisher/clock/job/inventory owner.
original_prototype.observable_later_gate: Hold identity/liking constant; changing only current rule or observed brace condition changes actual job eligibility. Show conserved paid repair,invalid claim without job,retained correction and independent refusal.
original_prototype.specific_review_response: Keeper cites the actual closure record and observed issue; no omniscient fine or private truth leak.
original_prototype.person_aftermath: Completed repair lets an independently willing learner use the reopened bench under their own agreement. While closed they may pay another available teacher or defer with their own purse,time and knowledge.
